correctness.rationale: All rotation-invariant stationary mixed moments through degree four follow rigorously from the jump-diffusion generator. The bounded active convolution justifies moment stationarity. Independent thermal Gaussian convolution gives second/fourth shifts. Exact first/second cosine moment feasibility follows from Jensen and |cos Psi|<=1; equality laws and strict derivative establish sharpness; direct high-rate limit and invertibility algebra are verified. Exact symbolic checks, an independent four-heading Markov calculation, and stochastic exact-event simulations are supporting corroboration rather than proofs.

The sharp fourth-moment interval and equality protocols reveal an observable orientation-memory degree of freedom invisible to effective-diffusion calibration; second-harmonic high-rate crossover supplies a measurable non-Gaussian limit and precise inverse moment inference.
